feature_name: RootSync and RepoSync resource limits override
summary: The spec.override.resources field lets users override resource limits for reconciler and git-sync containers.
extended_definition: The spec.override.resources field lets users override resource limits for reconciler and git-sync containers.

supporting_pages.title: Customize your Config Sync installation \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: If you need to override the resources for a root or namespace reconciler, you can use the spec.override.resources field in the RootSync or RepoSync object.

You can then later use kubectl commands to create additional RootSync objects or RepoSyncs that you can fully manage using kubectl commands later. apply-spec.yaml applySpecVersion : 1 spec : configSync : enabled : true If you don't have a source of truth yet, omit the following fields.
You can configure your RootSync or RepoSync object to sync from a Helm repository using the Kubernetes API , or declare it in another source of truth .

supporting_pages.title: "Monitor RootSync and RepoSync objects \_|\_ Config Sync \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: To change log verbosity, use the .spec.override.logLevels field as shown in the following example: apiVersion : configsync.gke.io/v1beta1 kind : RootSync metadata : name : root-sync namespace : config-management-system spec : override : logLevels : - containerName : "reconciler" logLevel : 0 - containerName : "git-sync" logLevel : 10 The value in the containerName field must be one of the following: reconciler , git-sync , hydration-controller , oci-sync , or helm-sync .

For example, the following output shows that a Deployment named nginx-deployment is ready: resourceStatuses: - group: apps kind: Deployment name: nginx-deployment namespace: default status: Current View logs For each RootSync and RepoSync object you create, Config Sync creates a reconciler Deployment to perform syncing.
For each RootSync or RepoSync object, a ResourceGroup is generated to capture the set of resources applied to the cluster and aggregate their statuses.
